Not your fault? We deal with the insurer.

If someone else caused the damage, you should not have to chase anyone. We send the photos and the estimate to the insurers, handle the back and forth, and keep you updated until your car is home.

  • In most cases you can choose who repairs your car
  • Photos and a written estimate sent straight to the insurer
  • Updates by WhatsApp until the job is done

Get yours looked at

Buying a used car? Check it first.

A clean history does not mean a clean car. Hidden repairs, filler and resprays only show up when someone measures the paint.

Pre-purchase bodywork inspection

Before you buy, we check every panel with a paint thickness gauge and inspect the car in bright light. You get a short written report with photos, so you know exactly what you are paying for.

[Price to confirm with SVR]

Questions we get asked

Do I have to use my insurer’s repairer?

[Confirm for Jersey insurers.] In most cases you can choose your own repairer. Check your policy, or ask us and we will help.

How long will it take?

Small repairs can take a day or two. Larger jobs depend on parts and damage. We give you a date with your estimate.

Will the colour match?

We use your car’s paint code, test on a spray-out card and blend into neighbouring panels. Paint fades over time, so we match what is on your car now.

Is the estimate really free?

Yes, with no obligation. Photos give a good guide; we confirm in person.

Do you offer a courtesy car?

[Confirm availability.] Ask when you book.

Privacy notice

Who we are

SVR – Sienna Vehicle Refinishing, [address], Jersey [JE_ ___]. Contact: [email@address].

What we collect

Only what you send us: your name, phone number, registration, car details, a description of the damage and any photos. Photos stay on your device until you send them by WhatsApp. This website does not upload or store them.

Why we use it

To reply to your enquiry, give you an estimate and carry out the repair. We do not sell your details or send marketing without asking first.

How long we keep it

[For example, up to two years after your last job.] Then it is deleted.

Who else sees it

No one outside SVR, except the services you choose to contact us through. Messages sent by WhatsApp are also handled by WhatsApp (Meta).

Your rights

You can ask to see, correct or delete your details at any time. If you are unhappy with how we use them, you can complain to the Jersey Office of the Information Commissioner.
